unverified.compression_ratio: Disputed: GM 1990 and 1992 Camaro kits say 8.5:1; NHRA CHEV-90/91/92 and PONT-90/91 say 9.0 for the 140-hp 191. Wikipedia gives none for LH0.
unverified.block_material: Cast iron: GM 1992 kit (MVMA 'Cylinder Block Cast Iron') and Wikipedia ('cast-iron block'). Only 2.
unverified.head_material: Cast iron per the GM 1992 kit (MVMA 'Cast Iron, 13.15 kg (29 lb)' in the head entry) and a Wikipedia passage saying Camaro versions kept iron heads. Wikipedia elsewhere implies aluminum heads for the 3.1. Not settled at 3 sources.
unverified.firing_order: 1-2-3-4-5-6 from the GM 1992 kit only. Brake & Front End gives coil pairs 1-4, 6-3, 2-5 (consistent, but not a firing order).
unverified.rod_length_in: Not found. The NHRA blueprints leave it blank for the 191.
unverified.fuel_type: Unleaded 87 gasoline per the GM 1992 kit (MVMA) only.

unverified_variants.found: NHRA CHEV-90 / PONT-90 list a 135-hp 191 (9.0:1, PFI), and Wikipedia gives 135 hp for 1988-89 LH0. That's the FWD rating, not Camaro/Firebird.
NHRA CHEV-90 lists a 142-hp 191 at 9.4:1 (different manifold part numbers). Probably a FWD application (e.g. Beretta/Corsica). Only NHRA.
